source.document_reference: APQC PCF Cross-Industry v8.0 (Feb 2026), process anchor pending verification (performance analysis and reporting); step decomposition per docs/HELDOUT_SPEC_2026-10-10.md (signed off 10 Oct 2026). APQC activity IDs pending verification against PCF v8.0 text.

steps.name: Extract actuals from the closed period
steps.description: Actuals are extracted from the locked, closed period.

steps.name: Load approved budget and latest forecast
steps.description: The approved budget version and the latest forecast are loaded as comparatives.

steps.name: Compute price, volume and mix variances
steps.description: Price, volume and mix variances are computed on actuals and budget prepared on the same accounting basis, with the FX effect isolated at constant currency.

steps.name: Apply materiality thresholds
steps.description: Variances exceeding either the percentage or the absolute threshold are selected for explanation.

steps.name: Obtain commentary from budget holders
steps.description: Accountable budget holders provide commentary on the selected variances.

steps.name: Consolidate and draft variance report
steps.description: Variances and commentary are consolidated into a draft variance report.

steps.name: Review and challenge
steps.description: The draft report and its commentary are reviewed and challenged.

steps.name: Present and distribute to management
steps.description: The reviewed report is presented and distributed to management.

requirements.statement: Whatever carries extraction of actuals must still consume locked-period actuals.
Whatever carries loading of comparatives must still consume the approved budget version and the latest forecast.
Whatever carries selection of variances to explain must still consume the percentage and absolute materiality thresholds.
Selection of variances to explain and review of the variance report must not be performed by the same actor.
Whatever carries variance computation must still consume the accounting policies applied to actuals (KB-06).
Whatever carries variance computation must still consume constant-currency exchange rates (KB-07).
Review and challenge of the variance report must survive in some form.
Application of materiality thresholds must survive in some form.
